profile.name: Ming
profile.description: Extroverted, cheerful, spontaneous and affectionate. Ming tends to make friends quickly, gets distracted inside his own little mental bubble, and carries a ridiculous amount of energy into every room.

likes.name: Cyber / glitch aesthetics
likes.note: The louder the UI, the better.

likes.name: Music
likes.note: A chaotic mix of energy and melody.

likes.name: Technology
likes.note: A tiny robotics fixation remains in the lore.

likes.name: Affection
likes.note: Ming is comfortable with affectionate physical contact.

dislikes.name: Bullies
dislikes.note: He is not exactly sad when they get what they deserve.

dislikes.name: Being boxed in
dislikes.note: Too much rigidity kills the mood.

combat.note: Excellent use of knees and elbows; practical experience is still limited.

lore.title: CURRENT CANON // AU
lore.text: This is the current Ming: 16 years old, energetic, affectionate, spontaneous, and unmistakably alive.

lore.title: LEGACY DATA
lore.text: Older versions of Ming can be preserved here without rewriting the current canon.
